agreements: Current v2.1 strictly validates secretary_signal_fresh, authority_conflict and event_independently_verified at its overlay entrypoint.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational progress only, never verified Experience by category alone.
HEARTBEAT, POLL, RETRY, WAIT, RECONNECT, scheduler wake, window age and uptime are zero Experience.
verified_progress_density is reason-only in the current executable and must remain observational/non-authoritative.
formal_mutation_allowed=false; v2.1 cannot mutate P_base, Identity, Personality or Governance.
GEARBOX_V2_1_CONTRACT correctly keeps speedup at NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.
Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved if v2/v2.1 is rejected.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events coerces event_id with str(...).strip() instead of requiring a bounded canonical identity. Integer 1 and string '1' silently alias, while mappings/lists/objects can be admitted through non-canonical string representations; logically equivalent structured IDs can stringify differently and evade dedupe, while distinct typed IDs can collapse accidentally.
disagreements.required_change: Define versioned EventIdentityV0_1. Require a bounded non-empty canonical string or canonical structured-envelope hash; reject bool/int/float/list/dict/object IDs instead of stringifying them. Bind accepted event_id to canonical_event_hash, evidence_hash, verifier receipt and durable rollback-resistant acceptance state.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict remain caller declarations without replay-resistant source/timestamp/TTL/policy/install binding.
disagreements.required_change: Use typed SecretarySignalEnvelope and AuthorityDecisionEnvelope bound to exact source, scope, freshness, policy and installation/runtime identity.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not project or enforce the actual fresh authority decision.
disagreements.required_change: Consume exact trusted authority state/gear constraints; missing, stale, revoked or cross-scope authority evidence fails closed.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum support, window, uncertainty or separate enter/exit hysteresis.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release behavior.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can lower gear_shift_rate while delaying necessary safe upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure throughput or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require matched performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; fewer shifts alone is not improvement.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still requires only event kind plus a boolean; no exact evidence hash, verifier identity or trusted C/independent-verifier receipt is required.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable evidence identity and trusted verifier receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only inside one aggregate invocation; same evidence under new IDs, cross-run replay, rollback/poll replay and same-ID rebinding can still be re-credited.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry with exact replay=no-op, same-evidence/new-ID=lineage duplicate and same-ID/different-binding=IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields, bypassing aggregate_experience_events and any future durable-ledger repair.
disagreements.required_change: Both credit classes must come from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: The public v2/experience_candidate_delta path remains callable directly and lacks the v2.1 strict verification boundary.
disagreements.required_change: Make one shared strict intake mandatory for v2/v2.1, or make legacy v2 credit-producing APIs research-only and non-authoritative.

disagreements.finding: Inherited route_drift, recovery_active, contradiction, hard_safety_conflict, rollback_required and standby lack a uniform literal-bool runtime boundary.
disagreements.required_change: Introduce one strict typed boolean boundary for all v1/v2/v2.1 control fields before routing.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 executes int(selected[1:]) although inherited v1/v2 can legally return N or R, so standby/rollback paths can raise ValueError.
disagreements.required_change: Handle N/R before G-gear parsing; N returns standby and R returns rollback immediately with zero credit and no anti-thrash interference.

disagreements.finding: current_gear is caller-supplied while controlling v2 hysteresis and v2.1 anti-thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive current_gear from canonical monotonic runtime/shift state bound to runtime/install identity and policy hash.

disagreements.finding: verification_stage is caller-supplied; self-reporting C_VERIFIED can remove the unverified G4 cap without exact C evidence.
disagreements.required_change: Derive verification_stage only from trusted verifier/acceptance receipts bound to exact mission, step, scope, evidence, freshness and revocation state.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events validates independently_verified before deciding whether a missing/irrelevant record is processable, so one malformed low-value record can abort a non-atomic batch and suppress later valid evidence.
disagreements.required_change: Use deterministic per-record rejection/quarantine unless the batch is explicitly atomic; rejected records get zero credit and consume no canonical identity.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 verified credits and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No executable matched paired-baseline protocol currently establishes speedup; commit count, wake count or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with uncertainty, full assigned-workload coverage and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: Non-canonical event_id coercion can create both false duplicate collapse and false replay uniqueness, corrupting longitudinal Experience and operational-progress counts.
Caller-forged secretary freshness, authority conflict, current gear or verification stage invalidates causal routing comparisons.
Small-n shift-rate estimates have extreme variance; a single >=0.50 threshold can false-trigger and chatter without independent release hysteresis.
Anti-thrash can reduce apparent gear_shift_rate while worsening cycle latency, verified closure throughput or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if later wired from policy-created progress back into upshift decisions.
Transient event identity plus direct decision-path credit can inflate longitudinal verified/operational totals.
Malformed-record whole-batch failure can create non-random missingness and bias Experience totals and paired speed/non-regression measurements.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
durable_progress_per_wake is denominator-sensitive; verified_closure_per_hour is exposure/censoring-sensitive; fixed treatment order and completed-only analysis add carryover and survivorship bias.
proposed_tests: GB21-EVENT-ID-TYPE-049: reject event_id values 1, 1.0, true, [], {}, and arbitrary objects; only the versioned bounded canonical identity type is accepted.
GB21-EVENT-ID-ALIAS-050: integer 1 and string '1' must not silently collapse through str coercion.

GB21-EVENT-ID-STRUCTURAL-REPLAY-051: logically equivalent mappings with different insertion order must not become different replay identities via Python str(dict); structured IDs are rejected or canonical-hashed.
GB21-FRESHNESS-FORGE-001 + AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: stale secretary cannot affect gear and trusted authority decision is projected exactly.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 + SHIFT-SMALL-N-004 + ANTI-THRASH-CHATTER-040 + RELEASE-041: canonical shift ledger, adequate support, uncertainty and bounded enter/exit behavior are required.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1 alone has zero routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.

GB21-EVENT-ID-REWRITE-008 + CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 + ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 + POLL-REPLAY-020 + EVENT-REBIND-021 + EVENT-ID-POISON-042: durable exactly-once and identity-conflict semantics survive restart/rollback/polling.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier/C receipt gets zero credit.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 + OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: receipt-less repeated decision calls create zero additional credit.
GB21-LEGACY-V2-BYPASS-047: direct legacy v2 calls cannot create authoritative verified credit outside the shared strict intake.
GB21-INHERITED-BOOL-BOUNDARY-045 + NR-STATE-043 + ROLLBACK-STATE-044: inherited controls have literal types and N/R safety states never enter numeric gear parsing.
GB21-MALFORMED-BATCH-ISOLATION-048: malformed irrelevant record creates bounded rejection but does not suppress unrelated valid evidence in a non-atomic batch.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-ONLY-013: DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND never alter verified Experience, P_base, Identity, Personality, Governance or formal authority.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 + WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030 + TIME-WINDOW-FREEZE-032 + ORDER-CROSSOVER-036 + ITT-WORKLOAD-COVERAGE-038: speedup requires matched workload, frozen denominator/exposure policy, crossover/order control, full assigned-workload coverage and uncertainty/non-regression.
release_condition: No formal/C claim from this review; verified v1 and Step009 baselines remain untouched.
Live/adoptable event identity is canonical, typed and durable; str-coercion IDs are forbidden.
Fresh secretary/authority inputs, current gear and verification stage are evidence-bound rather than caller declarations.
Verified Experience requires exact canonical evidence hash plus trusted independent-verifier/C acceptance receipt; operational progress remains separate.
All verified/operational credit originates from one rollback-resistant accepted-event/evidence-lineage registry and immutable acceptance receipt; decision-call frequency cannot create credit.
Anti-thrash uses canonical history, adequate sample support, uncertainty and bounded release hysteresis; safety/recovery downshift is immediate and performance non-regression is demonstrated.
5/4/3/1 weights remain heuristic and are never capability/Trust/Identity/Personality/promotion truth.

Speedup remains NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED until sealed matched-workload paired/crossover evidence improves durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency under frozen denominator/exposure/censoring/order/coverage rules with uncertainty and equal-or-better verification/risk quality.
Heartbeat/poll/retry/reconnect/window-age/runtime maintenance remain zero Experience; P_base remains read-only; real_5min_runtime_live remains false absent authorized always-on evidence.
